description: This file implements the ContinueWatching service API for a Thunder plugin, including token management, encryption/decryption, and configuration handling, with specific support for Netflix tokens.

classes.name: ContinueWatching
classes.description: Main plugin class managing token APIs and configuration.

classes.name: ContinueWatchingImpl
classes.description: Base class for token encryption/decryption and file operations.

classes.name: ContinueWatchingImplFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create platform-specific ContinueWatchingImpl instances.

methods.description: Retrieves the application token for a given app name.

methods.description: Sets the application token for a given app name.

methods.description: Deletes the application token for a given app name.

methods.name: ContinueWatching::deleteAppToken
